QuestInfo.name: Monarch's Power
QuestInfo.0: The #p1033210# is awake once more. Since you can't use your 2nd Advancement skills, you're worried you'll have to take the Monarch's Trial once again... Ask the #b#p1033210##k about it.
QuestInfo.1: The #p1033210# is surprised by your visit. She told you about everything that's happened while you slept, and about the curse. The #p1033210# assures you that you have acted with wisdom, and that you will regain your rightful strength as ruler of the Elves.
QuestInfo.2: The #p1033210# was surprised by your visit. She told you about everything that's happened while you slept, and about the curse. The #p1033210# assured you that you acted with wisdom, and that you will regain your rightful strength as ruler of the Elves. You won't have to go to her again to unlock your Job Advancements, because you already proved yourself worthy long ago.

0.0: Oh, wot's this? Now that I get a closer look at you, you're right weak, aren't you? What happened, anyhow? \r\n#L0##bIt's a long story...#l\n#k
0.1: I love me a long story! Remember, I'm a spirit, deary. I don't have much to do but float around and listen to stories. So come on, tell us!\r\n#L0##b(Tell her about the battle against the Black Mage, the curse, and present-day Maple World.)#l\n#k
0.2: Maybe it's my fault. Maybe I should have stayed out of the fight against the Black Mage, and spared my people this suffering. #p1033210#, if you feel I should step down as ruler, I will.\r\n#L0##bOh dear. Don't worry your little head. You're doing the best you can by the Elves. It's a right pity there's so much evil in Maple World.#l\n#k
0.3: You don't think this mean old Black Mage would've left the Fairies alone, do you? After he were done with the humans, you'd've been next, anyway. You were right to fight him the first time, and you're right to fight him this time...\r\n#L0##bGreat Spirit...#l\n#k
0.4: Don't you waste another moment second guessing yourself, deary. I'm not even gonna make you take the test again, neither. The Royal Power is all yours.
